extra_vocab.en: solved a problem or ended a disagreement
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the issue has been resolved 是現在完成式被動，表示問題已經解決，所以客戶確認後就可以結案。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: resolve 當「解決」時是及物動詞，被動 be resolved 表示「已解決」；resolve to V 則是「決心要…」，意思不同。

example.en: The new system resolves most login errors without help from staff.
example.zh: 新系統不需員工協助就能解決多數登入錯誤。

example.en: We are resolving the billing error and will update you soon.
example.zh: 我們正在處理帳單錯誤，很快會向你更新進度。

example.en: Our team worked overnight to resolve the issue with the server.
example.zh: 我們的團隊徹夜工作以解決伺服器的問題。

example.en: Both companies agreed to resolve the dispute without going to court.
example.zh: 兩家公司同意不經法院解決這項爭議。

example.en: The manager promised to resolve the complaint within three days.
example.zh: 經理承諾在三天內處理這項客訴。

examples.en: I am glad to inform you that your problem has been resolved.
examples.zh: 我很高興通知你，你的問題已經解決了。

examples.en: Has your question been resolved to your satisfaction today?
examples.zh: 你的問題今天已經解決到讓你滿意了嗎？

examples.en: The remaining issues must be resolved before the launch date.
examples.zh: 其餘問題必須在上市日之前解決。

examples.en: Once the delay is resolved, we can restart production.
examples.zh: 延誤一解決，我們就能重新開始生產。

similar.diff: solve 較通用，用於問題、謎題、計算；resolve 較正式，常用於爭議、客訴與正式問題。

example.en: Can you solve this problem before the client calls again?
example.zh: 你能在客戶再來電前解決這個問題嗎？

similar.diff: settle 常指雙方協議後結束爭議或付清款項。

example.en: The two firms settled the dispute out of court.
example.zh: 兩家公司在庭外和解了爭議。

similar.diff: fix 較口語，多指修好壞掉的東西或簡單的錯誤。

example.en: The technician fixed the printer in ten minutes.
example.zh: 技術人員十分鐘就修好了印表機。

example.en: We found a simple solution to the billing problem.
example.zh: 我們找到了帳單問題的簡單解決方法。

example.en: The dispute over the contract lasted three months.
example.zh: 合約爭議持續了三個月。

example.en: We received a complaint about the late delivery.
example.zh: 我們收到一則關於延遲送貨的客訴。

derived.link: resolve 變名詞，像 solve → solution，指「解決」或「決議」

senses.en: to find an answer to a problem

example.en: We resolved the payment error before the end of business.
example.zh: 我們在下班前解決了付款錯誤。

senses.en: to decide something formally or firmly
senses.distinguish: 後面接 to V 或 that 子句，表示決定要做某事時，是「決議」。

example.en: The board resolved to increase the training budget next year.
example.zh: 董事會決議明年增加培訓預算。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，re-open this case 指重新開啟已結案的案件。信中請對方直接回覆（reply all）這封信，就可以重啟案件。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: re-open 也常寫成 reopen（不加連字號）；後面直接接受詞，如 re-open a case。

example.en: The store re-opens on Monday after the long holiday.
example.zh: 這家店在長假後的星期一重新開門。

example.en: They re-opened the investigation after new evidence appeared.
example.zh: 新證據出現後，他們重新展開調查。

example.en: We are re-opening the case after the customer replied.
example.zh: 客戶回覆後，我們正在重啟這個案件。

example.en: The court agreed to re-open a case from last year.
example.zh: 法院同意重啟去年的一個案件。

example.en: Customers can re-open a ticket if the problem comes back.
example.zh: 如果問題再次出現，客戶可以重新開啟服務單。

example.en: Both sides plan to re-open negotiations next month.
example.zh: 雙方計畫下個月重啟談判。

examples.en: If the error returns, reply here and we will re-open your request.
examples.zh: 如果錯誤再次出現，請在此回覆，我們會重新開啟你的申請。

examples.en: The shop will re-open on Monday after the renovation.
examples.zh: 這家店整修後將在星期一重新開幕。

examples.en: We should not re-open this topic until the budget is approved.
examples.zh: 預算核准之前，我們不該重提這個議題。

similar.diff: reactivate 指重新啟用帳戶、服務或功能；re-open 指重新開啟案件或場所。

example.en: You can reactivate your account by logging in again.
example.zh: 你重新登入就可以重新啟用你的帳戶。

similar.diff: restart 是重新開始一個流程或程式；re-open 是把已關閉的東西再打開。

example.en: Please restart the process if the system stops working.
example.zh: 如果系統停止運作，請重新啟動流程。

example.en: We will close the case once you confirm.
example.zh: 你確認後，我們就會結案。

example.en: Service will resume as soon as the repair is finished.
example.zh: 維修完成後，服務就會立即恢復。

derived.link: open 是基礎字；加字首 re- 表示「再次」，變成 re-open
open + -ing，變成名詞，指「開始」或「空缺」
